# stapel-react — llms.txt index

19/27 packages describe their own surface in llms.txt as of this build.

Generated by `scripts/gen-root-llms.mjs` from each package's package.json (`description`) and llms.txt presence. Do not edit by hand.

An agent that does not yet know which package it needs reads this ONE file, then follows the link for that package's full surface (exports, hooks, operations, errors).

## Described (19)

- **@stapel/auth-react** — packages/auth-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-auth: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines (OTP, password, OAuth, TOTP, sessions, passkeys, QR, magic links, SSO), and the step-up verification factor flow. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/billing-react** — packages/billing-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-billing: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Since stapel-billing 0.8.0 a balance is a set of credit lots with expiry dates, so `useWallet` hands out `lots`, `holds` and the server's `expiringSoon` as LoadStates — a failed wallet read can never be drawn as a wallet with no credits, and neither the spend order nor the deadline is recomputed on the client. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin: <WalletPanel/> states the balance, when the expiring credits die, and the two ways to buy side by side with the price per credit under both.
- **@stapel/calendar-react** — packages/calendar-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-calendar: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/categories-react** — packages/categories-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-categories: a typed client, a client-assembled category tree, and the revision-delta sync the module documents. The list endpoint returns FLAT rows with treenode ancestry as comma-joined pk strings — this package parses them, builds the tree, resolves a slug to a category (the server has no slug lookup), walks breadcrumbs, and keeps the whole catalogue in an app-scoped repository refreshed by `?min_revision=` deltas instead of refetching it on every page. Category and feature names are TRANSLATION KEYS on the wire, never resolved labels, and the pair says so in its types. A category's feature schema is served typed for @stapel/attributes-react to draw and for search facets to label. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/cdn-react** — packages/cdn-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-cdn: a typed media-upload client whose flow is dedup-first — SHA-256 the bytes, ask file/exists/, and skip the POST entirely when the CDN already holds them. A phase-shaped upload bag (validate → hash → check → upload → variants), an ordered queue with per-item cancel/retry/remove and a max, object-URL previews with the revoke built in (@stapel/core's useObjectUrlPreview), and the opaque `<type>/<hash>` reference every consuming module actually stores. Client-side limits mirror the backend's own declared ceilings and never refuse what the server would accept. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/chat-react** — packages/chat-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-chat: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, a seq-ordered thread store, and ONE transport seam behind which the module's own resumable WebSocket protocol (hello/welcome/replay/replay_done/message/error) and seq-anchored polling are interchangeable — the UI never knows which is live. Conversation list with unread badges, thread replay + live tail, REST send, direct-thread idempotency for "message the seller", monotonic read markers. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/core** — packages/core/llms.txt — Stapel frontend runtime (L0): typed fetch with the Stapel error envelope, auth token/refresh seams, verification-403 interception, TanStack Query layer with per-user persistence, i18n engine, config provider, breakpoints hook.
- **@stapel/docs-react** — packages/docs-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-docs: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, snapshot-save discipline (If-Match head_seq), the editor_hint registry (registerDocEditor), headless components (documents / folder tree / editor / revisions / trash / upload / media), and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the self-themed antd skin (file manager, context menus, revision modal, editors) — every part swappable via the skin slot registry.
- **@stapel/forms-react** — packages/forms-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-forms: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, LoadState-disciplined headless bags (fill / builder / responses / list), a per-kind field-widget registry over the stapel-attributes vocabulary, client-side validation that mirrors the server's own error keys, the captcha_token seam and the X-Forms-Next-Before CSV export cursor. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the self-themed antd skin (StapelForm, FormBuilderPane, ResponsesPane, FormsListPane) — every field widget and skin slot swappable without a fork.
- **@stapel/gdpr-react** — packages/gdpr-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-gdpr — the deletion lifecycle a person can see: account closure with its cancellable grace, the entity erasures a host opens after its own delete (`useRequestErasure`), the pending-deletion list with `due_at` and `fully_erased_by`, the data export, and the DSAR intake in both its app and anonymous-form variants. Three of the module's 404s mean three different things — "nothing is being deleted" is one of them — so every refusal is read by CODE and a 404 that means "you are fine" is never rendered as a failure. Staff get the DSAR queue and the owner-health table where a silent data owner is a warning row, not an absent one. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; opt-in `/default` and `/default/admin` subpaths ship the antd skins.
- **@stapel/listings-react** — packages/listings-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-listings: a typed client over the draft twin, the composer that turns a category schema into a submittable listing, and the owner's dashboard. Two independent axes are rendered as two — lifecycle `status` decides visibility and `moderation_status` decides nothing about it, so an edit to a live listing stays live and says 'under review' instead of vanishing. Feature values are drawn and mirrored by @stapel/attributes-react; photos arrive as an injected upload bag whose `refs` ARE `images_draft` and whose `settled` gates the submit; a publish refusal is routed onto the control that caused it by slug. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/notifications-react** — packages/notifications-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-notifications: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/profiles-react** — packages/profiles-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-profiles: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/recordings-react** — packages/recordings-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-recordings: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, headless components (list / compose / upload-finalize), and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/reviews-react** — packages/reviews-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-reviews: ratings and reviews addressed the way the module addresses them — by an opaque (target_type, target_key) pair, never by a foreign key. An anchor-paginated list a guest can read, an aggregate that renders `no reviews yet` instead of a zero-star rating when count is 0, a submit form that reads the duplicate refusal by CODE (the module answers 400, not 409) and asks for a sign-in only where the write actually needs one, and moderation states shown as they are rather than hidden. The seller-level rating is a display over the composite's projection, because reviews itself cannot roll one up. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/search-react** — packages/search-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-search: a typed query client, TanStack Query hooks, and a URL-first state codec that makes a search shareable by construction (filters, ranges, geo, sort and the keyset cursor all live in the query string). Drill-down facets rendered with their remaining counts and with the server's own honesty flags — approximate, skipped, degraded — never swallowed; keyset pagination with the window refusal named; DSA Art. 26 `promoted` marking carried into every card slot and the P2B Art. 5 ranking disclosure exposed as data. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin, and /router binds the codec to react-router's useSearchParams.
- **@stapel/tokens** — packages/tokens/llms.txt — Stapel design tokens (§68 neutral colour-role dictionary): a single JSON source of truth compiled to a version-independent CSS custom-property core plus addressable adapters (Tailwind v4 default, v3 legacy), typed names, typography, spacing, radii, elevation, and the three breakpoints. Ships its OWN generator as the `stapel-tokens` bin — no host vendors/forks it. Not components.
- **@stapel/video-react** — packages/video-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-video's scope usage read: who in one partition talked how much, per calendar month. `useScopeUsage` runs the window read that feeds the month selector and the single-month read that feeds the rows, both over `GET /video/api/v1/scopes/{scope_key}/usage/`. The wire carries user IDs and never names, so the display resolves them through a host-supplied `nameFor` and falls back to the id rather than to a blank cell. The 404 that means "you may not read this scope", "this scope does not exist" and "this scope has no calls" all at once is rendered as an explained refusal, never as an empty table. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin and the workspace-admin screen its nav entry mounts.
- **@stapel/workspaces-react** — packages/workspaces-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-workspaces: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
